observations.behavior: Adds GatewayNotConfiguredError exception class, replacing ValueError for missing gateway configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing between a missing gateway configuration and a runtime gateway failure, preventing unnecessary error reporting for static configuration issues.

observations.behavior: Changes exception raised when gateway URL or API key is missing.
observations.code_quote: raise GatewayNotConfiguredError("LLM_GATEWAY_URL and an API key must be configured")
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the gateway client initialization to raise the new exception, distinguishing configuration absence from runtime failure.
